mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, password, name, phone, type_id, rank_id, unit_name, unit_code, enlist_date, discharge_date, login_provider, status, withdrawn_at, password_changed_at, created_date, created_nm, modified_date, modified_nm, del_yn FROM `user` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_yn = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` WHERE phone = #{phone} AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE `user` SET password = #{password}, password_changed_at = NOW(), modified_date = NOW(), modified_nm = #{modifiedNm} WHERE id = #{id} AND del_yn = 'N'
UPDATE `user` SET name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, unit_name = #{unitName}, unit_code = #{unitCode}, modified_date = NOW(), modified_nm = #{modifiedNm} WHERE id = #{id} AND del_yn = 'N'
UPDATE `user` SET status = 'WITHDRAWN', withdrawn_at = NOW(), del_yn = 'Y', modified_date = NOW(), modified_nm = #{modifiedNm} WHERE id = #{id} AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` (user_id, password, name, phone, type_id, rank_id, unit_name, unit_code, enlist_date, discharge_date, login_provider, status, created_date, created_nm, del_yn) VALUES (#{userId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{typeId}, #{rankId}, #{unitName}, #{unitCode}, #{enlistDate}, #{dischargeDate}, #{loginProvider}, #{status}, NOW(), #{userId}, 'N')
